campaign.title: Canonical actual-symbol balanced smooth quarter-packet interface

resource_policy.literature_policy: Use primary sources only to audit the literal signed quarter-packet hypotheses; do not import a coefficient-blind bilinear bound as a proof.

frozen_target.question: Can the proved balanced smooth reduction be rewritten as one standalone literal actual-symbol quarter-packet theorem, with exact constants, signs, owner scope, conjugate frequency, and capacity, or is there a first unresolved normalization seam?
frozen_target.reference_formula: T_small=(1/(2i)) sum_(G<L^(1/2)) G Q_G, where Q_G is the chi_4(u)-weighted difference of the 1/4 and 3/4 Poisson resonance packets; the open target is |sum_G G Q_G|<<_epsilon L^(3/2)X^epsilon.
quantities: fixed smooth gcd partition and coprime h=Gu,k=Gv decomposition
literal Vaaler taper, profiles, floors, stars, both quarter shifts and signs
exact-square, near-square and large-gcd prior owners
outside-absolute G-sum versus stronger shellwise l1 and Cauchy Gram

completion_criteria: Derive the exact chi_4 Poisson normalization and both quarter shifts independently.
Give a standalone literal definition of every actual packet coefficient and support label.
Prove the exact equivalence between the balanced physical child and the outside-absolute packet target after prior owners.
Separate the direct linear target from shellwise absolute, Cauchy, product-fibre and arbitrary-coefficient surrogates.
Audit the hard endpoint exclusion, smooth gcd boundary, frequency conjugacy, floors, stars, support crossings and real-X uniformity.
State the exact capacity deficit and the smallest non-self-returning signed survivor.
Do not claim the analytic packet estimate, M9-M2, endpoint uniformity, M9, or an exponent unless the full chain closes.

tasks.target: Independently derive the exact quarter-packet Poisson identity, signs, norm hierarchy, conjugacy and logical implication from the frozen statement only.
excluded_context: prior balanced-packet derivations and all Round-112 sibling reports
required_output: Finite sign, conjugacy and norm countermodels.

tasks.target: Write the full literal actual-symbol packet, owner dictionary and physical equivalence for every balanced smooth residual label.
required_output: A standalone literal finite packet formula and owner table.
An exact physical implication and first unproved estimate.

tasks.target: Audit every normalization and owner seam, reject false unsigned or hard-endpoint imports, and map the closest primary theorems.
required_output: Certification or the first exact failed seam.
A smallest lawful survivor and graph recommendation.

review_seams.requirement: The two quarter shifts, signs, Fourier convention and 1/(2i) factor are exact.
Every physical profile, floor, star, support crossing and real-X label is retained.
Smooth balanced, hard endpoint and unbalanced packets are disjoint, and prior owners occur once.
The global outside-absolute packet is not replaced by shellwise l1 or Gram without a bridge.
No analytic or downstream promotion without the missing signed estimate.
